newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van Lanschot sees 1997 profit up at least 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Van Lanschot sees 1997 profit up at least 10 pct.

text.p: Dutch bank F. van Lanschot Bankiers said on Wednesday it expected profits to rise again in 1997 by a minimum of 10 percent.

"On the basis of continuing growth in the client base and good business in the elapsed period of the current year, the bank expects to again be able to realise a higher profit in 1997," it said in a statement with its 1996 results.
In a summary of its chairman's speech released before delivery, it said the rise would be a minimum of 10 percent.
Earlier, Van Lanschot reported 1996 net profits of 73.1 million guilders, versus 56.0 million guilders in 1995.
